sourceSentences: [0] Can threaten your ADC with engage, but his range is predicatable. Q his engage or disengage after his combo
[0] You can't cleanse knock-ups, he has high base damage, and he can easily out-roam/out-pressure you.
[0] Facing a durable engage matchup like Alistar is tough to punish unless he makes a mistake in his combo. Aery poke isn't effective against his passive sustain.
[1] Countering Milio's Ultimate Milio's ultimate removes all crowd control effects except for knock-ups. Therefore, it's crucial to initiate with Alistar's Q (Pulverize) knock-up.
[1] Force Milio to use his ultimate with a W-Q combo, or guide your allied damage dealers to attack from outside Milio's ultimate range.

[1] Countering Milio's Q Skill Milio's Q (Ultra Mega Fire Kick) can interrupt Alistar's W (Headbutt) dash. It's best to engage after confirming Milio has used his Q, or to use Flash to dodge Milio's Q while engaging.

[1] An experienced Milio will be able to disrupt your engage using his Q and when you finally manage to lock someone down, his R has a cleansing effect which saves enemies that you hit with your E. A pretty annoying matchup!
